neighbours.label: Starting a new sentence immediately after a numeral followed by a period and a space.
fire: The thermometer settled at 18. We wrote the value in the notebook.
After recounting, the number of tickets was 47. They closed the sales desk.
The display showed channel 9. She adjusted the antenna carefully.
At the final whistle, our score was 62. Everyone left the court quietly.
The invoice listed a total of 83. Our accountant checked the arithmetic.
The instructions refer to section 12. It explains the assembly process.
By sunset, the counter had reached 305. A volunteer reset the display.
The package carried identification number 71. You could read it through the wrapper.
quiet: Our notebook recorded a temperature of eighteen. We checked the reading again.
The ticket count came to forty-seven. They locked the sales desk afterward.
She found channel nine on the display. The antenna needed another adjustment.
We finished with sixty-two points. Everyone walked away from the court.
An accountant verified a total of eighty-three. Our invoice was then filed.
For assembly details, consult section twelve. It contains the necessary instructions.
A volunteer watched the counter reach three hundred five. The display was then reset.
You could read identification number seventy-one. The wrapper did not obscure it.

notes: The top examples usually start a sentence after digits and a full stop; some instead follow a single-letter abbreviation. The registered hypothesis tests the numeric subset against the same kinds of quantities written out as words. No general topic interpretation is claimed.
